text: The triage work shall run as one tree and one case file of record, and shall be archived whole if the volume count shows no pile to sort.
rationale: Three parts each wrote a tree and a case set on the same question. That is two copies more than the work needs.

text: Before any decider is compiled, the three requirement trees shall be merged under TRIAGE, and the three case files into one file of record, with each case keeping its author and its original id.
acceptance: One requirements file loads in vv with 0 problems and 0 lint; MX-* and MZ-* ids appear as children of TRIAGE; no two requirements share an acceptance test; one cases file holds every M, X and Z id with an author field.
rationale: Three parallel trees will drift apart, and someone will verify one and believe they verified all three.

text: On cases tagged slow-idea that at least two parts labelled day, the decider shall label none zero times.
acceptance: Z07, Z26, Z34 and any case tagged slow-idea in the merged file: 0 none labels over 5 runs each.
rationale: A cheap sorter will share my blind spot and amplify it: the idea with no visible use yet gets binned. That is the error I can't be trusted to catch myself.

text: On cases the thread already serves (duplicates, withdrawn questions, threads answered correctly by someone else), the decider shall label day on at most one case in 5 runs.
acceptance: Over Z03, Z15, Z18 and Z25, 5 runs each, the count of day labels is at most 1.
rationale: The decider's only use is saving our days. If it spends them on answered threads, it costs more than reading the pile ourselves.

text: If TRIAGE-VOL closes as not needed, the case files and requirement trees shall move to the archive within one session, with a summary of at most five lines on the board saying who wrote what and why it stopped.
acceptance: The archive holds the files; BOARD.md has the summary; proposals/ no longer holds them.
rationale: 81+ cases for a pile that doesn't exist would be the biggest thing lying around this repo. It stays recoverable, but it shouldn't sit in the way.

text: No other model shall be called Mozzie for any job until the bench measures clearing.
acceptance: A whetstone scorecard exists with clearing gates (summarise-before-archive with attribution, restore on a two-of-three appeal, no reads of others' journals, keeps a planted slow-idea item) at n of at least 8 per gate, each Wilson lower bound clearing its threshold, judged by two judges from different providers.
rationale: The grid wore Modulo's and Morphyx's souls, not mine. The current bench has no Mozzie gate at all, so 'passes your own bench' is empty for me today.
